decisions.reason: The product has not been visible since 2020, the firm has already cut most of its 2018 launches, and the 2020–2021 downturn in machinery likely pushed results below aspiration, so management would fold this component back into the core air cooler business.

Despite the lack of recent visibility and the firm's pattern of pruning, the enhanced tubes rest on its own R&D and efficiency strategy, and slack from a growing industry lets it carry this capability while results remain uncertain.
